decisions.title: DATA-2 duplicate handling and split rule
decisions.text: Pinned BANKING77 to revision 57ec275d8078af65b7731c2a98be812d844a6d6b. Before inspecting matches, fixed NFKC/casefold/word normalization and token Jaccard threshold 0.9. Connected lexical groups remain together. Preserve all selected official test rows; exclude official train rows in test-overlapping groups. Hash whole groups with seed 20261011 for an approximate 20 percent validation share. This is lexical screening, not proof of semantic independence. Keep source bytes and original membership; derived records retain source row, text hash and revision. No test result was used to select model settings.

knowledge.title: DATA-1 complete: scenario and review checks
knowledge.text: Implemented src/schema.py and tests/test_schema.py with the Python standard library. Twelve tests passed through the Genesis gate. All 20 source cases retain checksum 6f39e4b4fa64f580d5c1b54ffd143d171fcf3454ee4d325c8b1570b178145a20 and remain unreviewed/ineligible. Separate review events require a source hash, identity string, timezone timestamp and valid decision. Later reject/defer events revoke eligibility. Checks cannot authenticate a reviewer or establish banking correctness. Current schema intentionally accepts development synthetic proposals only; final data schemas belong to later tasks. Updated administrative status in README, PLAN and START_HERE after completion. DATA-2 is active but not implemented.
